hero.subtitle: The AI & Young Professionals Summit & Innovation Challenge

about.summary: UNLOCK is an AI workplace innovation challenge and grand expo run with iCEP at UiTM Shah Alam. Ten teams (five University Student teams and five Young Professional teams) join a 3-week virtual incubation sprint, then showcase working prototypes at the physical UNLOCK Summit on 6 December 2026.
about.vision: To become a leading platform that bridges academia and industry in nurturing an innovative, AI-ready generation capable of shaping a sustainable, ethical and future-driven workforce.
about.mission: To empower students and young professionals with AI knowledge, innovative thinking, and practical problem-solving skills while fostering meaningful collaboration between academia and industry to promote ethical and responsible AI adoption in the workplace.
about.objective: To enhance knowledge and understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in the workplace, encourage the development of innovative ideas and practical AI-driven solutions, and strengthen strategic collaboration among universities, industries, and communities towards ethical, responsible, and sustainable AI adoption.

timeline.title: Pre-registration Closes
timeline.detail: Pay later: payment details are emailed after you pre-register. First come, first served. Only 5 team spots per category.

timeline.title: Workshop 1: Kickoff & Framing
timeline.detail:
Workshop 1, Saturday 14 November, online
• Virtual Soft Launch (Welcome, talk/speech from collaborators, introduce the challenge, the journey ahead and the challenge platform)
• Applied AI Literacy in the Workplace (How AI is applied in real workplaces; tools teams can use, rules and regulations, and the overall process of the competition)
• Kahoot Quiz time (Online game engagement)
• Virtual Meet 1: Modern AI Prototyping Tools (Instructors explain tools and other AI software teams can use to build, including an Apexelerate introduction)
• Task Scenario Draw (Each team draws its scenario under one of the 6 industry challenge tracks; instructors assign a topic/problem and guide on tools such as website, landing page, system, apps)
• 1-page proposal kickoff using Apexelerate (Teams start drafting their 1-page proposal)
Team output: a 1-page proposal. 5 mentors from HackDev guide the teams.

timeline.title: Workshop 2: System Architecture
timeline.detail:
Workshop 2, Saturday 21 November, online
• Virtual Meet 2, Part 1: Technical Briefs using Apexelerate (Teams turn their problem statement outline into a technical brief)
• Short 15-minute Break
• VS Code Session (Instructor-led session on using Visual Studio Code so teams can begin building)
• Preparation / Buffer Time (Time for teams to prepare for the wireframing session)
• Virtual Meet 2, Part 2: Wireframing (System logic, user flows and interface models; teams explain their proposed innovations in greater detail)
Tuesday, 24 November: Prototype Presentation Slides Submission. Slides explain the proposed prototype: features, wireframes, system logic and overall framework. The actual prototype is not required at this stage.
Team output: a technical brief and framework.

timeline.title: Workshop 3: Prototype & Selection
timeline.detail:
Workshop 3, Saturday 28 November, online
• Virtual Meet 3: Technical refinement & testing (Teams refine and improve their prototypes with instructor support: coding, system functionality, logic, design, debugging and testing; slots for talks with the industry)
• Short break (Gives the panel time to prepare)
• Comprehensive evaluation (video, slides and links) (Industry panels, including iCEP, evaluate all 10 prototypes (about 6 min each))
• Selection (Judges select the Top 3 finalists in each category (Student and Young Professional) for the Main Stage pitch; all 10 teams advance to exhibit booths at the Grand Finale)
Submission: presentation slides and a demonstration video of the refined prototype, due Tuesday, 1 December 2026.
Team output: a working prototype, submitted for evaluation.

timeline.detail: UNLOCK: The AI & Young Professionals Summit & Innovation Challenge. Dewan Annex / Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.

faqs.a: Active Malaysian university students (undergraduate and postgraduate) join the Student Category, and early-career working adults join the Young Professional Category.
faqs.alt: If you are a university student (undergraduate or postgraduate), register in the Student Category. If you are an early-career working adult, register as a Young Professional.

faqs.a: This is a pre-registration. Only the team leader registers, once, using the Student form or the Young Professional form in the Register section. You do not pay now: we email the payment details later. Then confirm your members with the second form from your confirmation email, and join the WhatsApp group at the end.
faqs.alt: Choose the Student or Young Professional pre-registration form in the Register section. The team leader fills it in once and pays later, when we email the payment details. Then follow the confirmation email to confirm the members and join the WhatsApp group.

faqs.q: Should every team member fill in the registration form?
faqs.a: No. Only the team leader or an authorised representative fills in the main form, to avoid duplicate team records. Members complete the member-confirmation form later.
faqs.alt: No. One person per team (the leader or an authorised representative) submits the main form. Members only complete the second member-confirmation form.

faqs.kw: team size members pasukan how many spots
faqs.a: The cohort has 10 teams (50 talents): 5 Student teams and 5 Young Professional teams. Every team has exactly 5 members.
faqs.alt: There are 10 team places in total: 5 for students and 5 for young professionals. Each team must have exactly 5 people.

faqs.a: Customer Experience & Support, HR & Talent Operations, Operations & Productivity, Marketing & Content, Data & Decision-Making, and Sustainability & ESG. Each team picks one.
faqs.alt: Pick one of Customer Experience & Support, HR & Talent Operations, Operations & Productivity, Marketing & Content, Data & Decision-Making, or Sustainability & ESG.

faqs.kw: when date tarikh schedule timeline deadline
faqs.a: Registration closes on Monday 9 November 2026. The Saturday sprint sessions are on 14, 21 and 28 November, and the Grand Finale and UNLOCK Summit is on Sunday 6 December 2026.
faqs.alt: Remember these dates: 9 Nov (registration closes), 14, 21 and 28 Nov (Saturday sprint sessions) and 6 Dec 2026 (Grand Finale and summit).

faqs.kw: venue location lokasi where uitm held happening place address dewan finale grand
faqs.a: The Grand Finale is at Dewan Annex / Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam. The 3-week sprint is online.
faqs.alt: The 3-week sprint is online. The Grand Finale on 6 December is in person at Dewan Annex / Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.

faqs.a: Week 1: kickoff, applied AI literacy and prototyping tools. Week 2: system architecture and wireframing. Week 3: prototype refinement and finalist selection.
faqs.alt: Week 1 is the kickoff and AI literacy, Week 2 covers system architecture and wireframes, and Week 3 is prototype testing and finalist selection.

faqs.kw: judging criteria weightage marks scoring judged scored marked evaluated assessed score rubric
faqs.a: Judges look at Innovation and Originality, AI Integration & Technical Soundness, Problem Relevance & Track Alignment, Feasibility & Practical Functionality, Scalability & Organizational Impact, Pitch Presentation & Prototype Demo, and Future Potential & Roadmap.
faqs.alt: Teams are assessed on seven areas: originality, AI and technical soundness, problem relevance, feasibility, scalability and impact, the pitch and demo, and future potential.

faqs.kw: prize award trophy hamper medal hadiah
faqs.a: 6 official trophies (Top 3 per category), 9 appreciation hampers (Top 6 teams plus People's Choice winners) and 50 commemorative finalist medals for every participant.
faqs.alt: Winners receive 6 trophies and 9 hampers (including People's Choice), and all 50 participants receive a commemorative finalist medal.

faqs.q: What do we have to submit?
faqs.kw: deliverables submission requirements proposal prototype slides video deadline 24 november 1 december
faqs.a: Step by step: a 1-page proposal (Workshop 1); a technical brief and framework (Workshop 2); prototype presentation slides by Tuesday 24 November 2026 (no working prototype needed yet); presentation slides and a demonstration video of your refined prototype by Tuesday 1 December 2026; and for the Grand Finale, a pitch deck (10-minute presentation, no Q&A), a booth setup for Zone B, and the AI-Use Declaration.
faqs.alt: Your pack builds up over the weeks: 1-page proposal, technical brief and framework, prototype slides (due Tue 24 Nov, no prototype needed yet), then slides plus a demo video (due Tue 1 Dec). On finale day you bring the pitch deck, your Zone B booth setup and the AI-Use Declaration.

faqs.a: An official form explaining which AI tools, models and APIs you used and how you prompted them. All third-party tools must be disclosed.
faqs.alt: It is an official form where you list every AI tool, model and API you used and describe how you prompted them.

faqs.q: Who pitches live at the finale?
faqs.a: The Top 3 Student teams and Top 3 Young Professional teams pitch live on the Main Stage (Zone A). All 10 teams exhibit at booths in Zone B.
faqs.alt: Six teams take the Main Stage in Zone A: the Top 3 Students and the Top 3 Young Professionals. All 10 teams still exhibit in Zone B.

faqs.a: An interactive visitor journey (Discover, Engage, Validate, Unlock) that takes delegates through all 10 team booths, with rewards to redeem.
faqs.alt: It is a visitor journey (Discover, Engage, Validate, Unlock) that guides delegates around all 10 booths so they can redeem rewards.

faqs.q: How does the People's Choice Award work?
faqs.a: Summit delegates vote directly across all 10 exhibition booths.
faqs.alt: Delegates at the summit vote at the 10 exhibition booths, and the most-voted team wins the People's Choice Award.

faqs.q: What is Zone A and Zone B?
faqs.a: Zone A is the Main Stage conference with talks, the final pitch and the awards. Zone B is the exhibition floor where all 10 teams run interactive booths.
faqs.alt: Zone A is the main stage for talks, the final pitches and the awards. Zone B is the exhibition floor with all 10 team booths.

faqs.q: Can I join more than one team?
faqs.a: No. Each participant joins one team and one track only.
faqs.alt: No. You can only be in one team and one track.

faqs.q: Can we use private company data?
faqs.a: Not without clearance. Projects must follow the PDPA, with no unencrypted personal records, credentials or proprietary databases.
faqs.alt: Only with clearance. Projects must follow the PDPA and must not use unencrypted personal records, credentials or proprietary databases.

faqs.a: IP infringement, not disclosing core AI-generated code, fabricated results, late delivery outside approved windows, or unapproved absence from required sprint checkpoints.
faqs.alt: Copying others' IP, hiding core AI-generated code, made-up results, late delivery outside approved windows, or missing required checkpoints without approval.

faqs.alt: You pay later. Filling in the form is a pre-registration, and we send the payment details by email afterwards: RM65 per team for students and RM180 per team for young professionals.

officialName: UNLOCK: The AI & Young Professionals Summit & Innovation Challenge

askOnly.q: What is UNLOCK?
askOnly.kw: unlock about event summit challenge apa
askOnly.a: UNLOCK is an AI workplace innovation challenge and grand expo with iCEP PETRONAS at UiTM Shah Alam. Ten teams build working AI prototypes in a 3-week online sprint, then showcase them at the summit on 6 December 2026.
askOnly.alt: It is the AI & Young Professionals Summit & Innovation Challenge: a 3-week online incubation followed by a physical Grand Finale at UiTM Shah Alam, where 10 teams exhibit their AI prototypes.

askOnly.q: Who organises UNLOCK?
askOnly.kw: organiser organizer committee penganjur
askOnly.a: UNLOCK is run by the UNLOCK committee at UiTM Shah Alam in collaboration with iCEP PETRONAS, with HackDev as a partner.
askOnly.alt: The UNLOCK committee organises it, with UiTM Shah Alam as host, iCEP PETRONAS as anchor industry partner and HackDev as a partner.

askOnly.q: When does registration close?
askOnly.kw: deadline closing last date tutup closes
askOnly.a: Registration closes on Monday 9 November 2026, or earlier if all 5 team places in a category are filled.
askOnly.alt: You have until 9 November 2026, but each category has only 5 team places, so the form closes as soon as they are taken. Check the live team spots on this page.

askOnly.q: Is the event online or physical?
askOnly.kw: online physical hybrid venue location held
askOnly.a: Both. The 3-week workshop sprint is online, and the Grand Finale on 6 December 2026 is in person at Dewan Annex / Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.
askOnly.alt: The weekly workshops are online on Saturdays. The final summit is physical at UiTM Shah Alam.

askOnly.q: How much is the registration fee?
askOnly.kw: fee yuran cost price free percuma bayar payment pay
askOnly.a: The registration fee is RM65 per team for the Student category and RM180 per team for the Young Professional category. For now it is a pre-registration, so you pay later: we email the payment details after you pre-register.
askOnly.alt: It is RM65 per team for students and RM180 per team for young professionals. You do not pay at pre-registration; we email the payment details afterwards.

askOnly.q: Do I need AI or coding experience?
askOnly.kw: experience beginner coding skill programming pengalaman knowledge
askOnly.a: Week 1 teaches Applied AI Literacy in the Workplace and modern AI prototyping tools, and Week 2 guides you through wireframing and system design, so the workshops help you build your prototype. If you are unsure about your team's skills, ask us.
askOnly.alt: The sprint is guided: AI literacy and prototyping tools in Week 1, architecture and wireframing in Week 2, and prototype testing in Week 3. For specific concerns about skills, contact the committee.

askOnly.q: What will we build?
askOnly.kw: build project prototype create product idea innovation
askOnly.a: A working AI prototype or proof of concept that solves a realistic workplace problem in your chosen track, with clear user workflows and measurable business impact.
askOnly.alt: Each team designs and builds an AI-powered solution for a real organisational challenge, showing the problem, the AI architecture, the user flows and the expected impact.

askOnly.q: Can students and professionals be in the same team?
askOnly.kw: mixed same team combine both category
askOnly.a: Each team registers under one category: Student for university students, or Young Professional for early-career working adults. If your team is mixed, please ask the committee before registering.
askOnly.alt: Teams are registered as either Student or Young Professional. For a mixed team, contact us so we can advise you.

askOnly.q: What if my team has fewer than 5 members?
askOnly.kw: fewer less four members incomplete exactly short
askOnly.a: Every team must have exactly 5 members. If you are still looking for members, ask the committee how we can help.
askOnly.alt: The rule is strictly 5 members per team, so please complete your team before registering. Contact us if you need advice.

askOnly.q: How are the finalists chosen?
askOnly.kw: finalist selection select top 6 evaluate chosen
askOnly.a: In Week 3, industry panels including iCEP PETRONAS evaluate all 10 prototypes. The Top 3 Student and Top 3 Young Professional teams are chosen to pitch live.
askOnly.alt: After the Week 3 prototype submission, the judges score every team with the rubric, and the top 3 from each category go to the Main Stage.

askOnly.q: Do all teams join the summit?
askOnly.kw: all teams attend booth exhibit summit finale everyone
askOnly.a: Yes. All 10 teams advance to the Grand Finale and set up interactive booths in Zone B. Only the Top 6 also pitch on the Main Stage.
askOnly.alt: Every team exhibits at the summit. The 6 finalists present on stage as well.

askOnly.q: What do we need to prepare for the summit?
askOnly.kw: bring prepare booth setup what to bring
askOnly.a: A working prototype and an interactive booth setup for Zone B. Booth setup times and the stage schedule will be sent by email and WhatsApp.
askOnly.alt: Prepare your prototype, your booth exhibition setup and, if you are a finalist, your 10-minute pitch. We will email the schedule.

askOnly.q: How long is the pitch?
askOnly.kw: pitch presentation minutes duration time slot
askOnly.a: The pitch is a 10-minute presentation with no Q&A.
askOnly.alt: Finalists get 10 minutes on the Main Stage, and there is no Q&A session after it.

askOnly.q: Will the workshops be recorded?
askOnly.kw: recording record youtube replay miss class rakaman
askOnly.a: Yes. Class recordings are unlisted on YouTube, and the link is sent in the WhatsApp community and by email.
askOnly.alt: Recordings are shared as unlisted YouTube links through the WhatsApp community and email, so you can catch up if you miss a class.

askOnly.q: Where are the workshops held?
askOnly.kw: workshop class link zoom online where how join
askOnly.a: The workshops are online. You will receive the class link by email and WhatsApp one day before each session.
askOnly.alt: Classes run online on Saturdays 14, 21 and 28 November. We send the join link a day before, together with the weekly attendance form.

askOnly.q: Do I have to attend every class?
askOnly.kw: attendance absent compulsory miss required hadir
askOnly.a: Attendance matters: there is a weekly attendance form, and unapproved absence from required sprint checkpoints can lead to disqualification. Tell the committee in advance if you cannot attend.
askOnly.alt: Please attend all three sessions and complete each week's attendance form. Missing a required checkpoint without approval risks disqualification, so inform us early.

askOnly.q: Can we use ChatGPT or other AI tools?
askOnly.kw: chatgpt gemini claude copilot ai tools allowed llm api
askOnly.a: Yes, third-party AI models, APIs and frameworks are allowed, but you must disclose all of them in the official AI-Use Declaration. Plagiarism and fabricated data are not allowed.
askOnly.alt: AI tools are part of the challenge. Just declare every tool and how you used it in the AI-Use Declaration.

askOnly.q: Will there be certificates?
askOnly.kw: certificate sijil medal
askOnly.a: All 50 participants receive a commemorative finalist medal for completing the incubation and exhibition. For certificate details, please contact the committee.
askOnly.alt: Every participant gets a finalist medal. If you need information on certificates, email us.

askOnly.q: Who are the judges and mentors?
askOnly.kw: judge panel mentor instructor speaker juri
askOnly.a: Industry panels, including anchor partner iCEP PETRONAS, evaluate the prototypes. The teams are guided by 5 mentors from our partner HackDev. For the names of judges, mentors and speakers, please follow our social media or contact the committee.
askOnly.alt: The prototypes are judged by industry panels with iCEP PETRONAS, and 5 mentors from HackDev guide the teams. Announcements about speakers and mentors are shared through our official channels.

askOnly.q: How can I contact the committee?
askOnly.kw: contact reach email hubungi help support
askOnly.a: You can email us from the Contacts section, or message @unlockai.project on Instagram and TikTok.
askOnly.alt: Use the Contacts section on this page for our email, or follow @unlockai.project on Instagram and TikTok.

askOnly.q: How do I know my team is registered?
askOnly.kw: confirm registered confirmation email registration id check status
askOnly.a: The team leader and every member whose email you entered receive a confirmation email with your Registration ID. The live team spots on this page also update.
askOnly.alt: After you submit the form, check your inbox (and spam folder) for the confirmation email with your Registration ID.

askOnly.q: I did not receive the confirmation email
askOnly.kw: no email not received spam missing didn't got
askOnly.a: Please check your spam or promotions folder and wait a few minutes. If it still has not arrived, email us with your team name and the email you used.
askOnly.alt: Confirmation emails go to the team leader and every member email on the form. If yours is missing, contact us with your team name so we can check.

askOnly.q: Can I change my team members after registering?
askOnly.kw: change replace edit update withdraw cancel member swap tukar
askOnly.a: Please contact the committee as soon as possible so we can check what can be changed. An email is the fastest way.
askOnly.alt: Changes to a registered team need the committee's approval. Contact us with your team name and the change you need.

askOnly.q: Who is on the UNLOCK team?

askOnly.a: The committee is led by President Syed Aiman Hafique and Vice President Syaza Athirah, advised by Dr. Ahlam Abdul Aziz and Dr. Nurul Atiqah binti Mohd Azlan. askOnly.alt: UNLOCK is advised by Dr. Ahlam Abdul Aziz and Dr. Nurul Atiqah binti Mohd Azlan. See them on the Our Team page.
